title: Client 1 rehearsal 3: the synthetic same-shape set (134 places, 666 items, 600 balances) on a tenant created by the registration process (route 3)
description: Walks docs/runbooks/qoimeks-rehearsal.md in its order on a throwaway tenant made by POST /api/v1/onboarding as the platform administrator (the same platform.register_tenant process as POST /admin/v1/tenants; the runner holds no provisioner credential). No idp_realm_id is sent (decision 0072), so the tenant is not loginable and every step that needs the tenant's own administrator is marked blocked_by (counted BLOCKED, not failed) until onboarding-created tenants get a realm (T-2727 provisioner wiring; PM decision). PLAYED: the registration, its completion and the tenant read, and the cleanup (deactivate). BLOCKED, in the runbook order: org master data, allow_negative, check-only runs, load, headers, issue and approve, balances read-back, the quantity compare and the masters compare. The counts compare (qoimeks_compare.sh) needs a database snapshot and stays an operator check; counts are compared only through the API (page_through totals). Synthetic data only (D-050), QA only, nothing on production. Expected values of the played steps follow BP-PLATFORM-01; no record entry exists until a real QA run does. The blocked steps name the actor 'storekeeper' only because the actor roster has no entry for a tenant admin that cannot sign in; they are never sent.

steps.says: Route 3: the platform administrator registers the throwaway Client 1 rehearsal tenant through the registration process (POST /api/v1/onboarding starts platform.register_tenant, the same process as POST /admin/v1/tenants): 202 with an instance id. No idp_realm_id is sent (decision 0072).
The registration instance runs to its end (instance reads are uppercase).
The tenant exists and is active (tenant reads are lowercase).
Org master data of the new tenant: legal entity, site, org unit, employee (docs/runbooks/qoimeks-rehearsal.md, 'Minimum master data by API'). NOT PLAYED until the tenant is loginable.
